vod_catalog.source: Internet Archive public-domain film and classic TV collection
vod_catalog.note: On-demand test catalogue. Separate from the live M3U lineup and the XMLTV guide: these are finite films and episodes, not linear channels.

items.title: PremiumTV Test Card
items.summary: A 65-second synthetic clip generated for the Movies & Shows shelf: a moving test pattern, a running timecode, the title text and a tone with a beep on every whole second. If the picture moves, the clock counts and the beeps land on each second, video, audio and text all reached the player.

items.title: Beat the Devil
items.summary: John Huston and Truman Capote's sly caper stars Humphrey Bogart, Jennifer Jones, Gina Lollobrigida, and Peter Lorre as schemers stranded in an Italian port while chasing African uranium land.

items.title: Carnival of Souls
items.summary: During a drag race, Mary Henry and her two friends are forced off of a bridge. Their car sinks into the depths of a river. Mary emerges unharmed from the river, the sole survivor of the crash. She begins a new life as a church organist. Mary suddenly finds herself haunted by a ghostly figure that seems to stalk her. items.summary: Hilarious romantic comedy starring Cary Grant and Rosalind Russell. Russell is rough and tumble reporter looking to get out of the news racket by marrying and becoming a house wife after her divorce from newspaper publisher Grant. items.title: McLintock!
items.summary: John Wayne and Maureen O'Hara headline a boisterous frontier comedy about cattle baron George Washington McLintock, family feuds, and a town on the brink of statehood.

items.title: Night of the Living Dead
items.summary: George A. Romero's landmark survival horror film: seven strangers barricade themselves inside a rural Pennsylvania farmhouse as the recently deceased rise across the countryside.

items.title: Nosferatu
items.summary: Directed by F. W. Murnau. Based on Bram Stoker's 1897 novel Dracula, this German silent horror film follows estate agent Thomas Hutter as he travels to Transylvania to arrange the purchase of a house for the mysterious Count Orlok. Orlok's arrival in Hutter's hometown brings with it a spreading plague and a terrifying supernatural presence.Starring Max Schreck, Gustav von Wangenheim, Greta Schröder, and Alexander…

items.title: Plan 9 from Outer Space
items.summary: Ed Wood's cult sci-fi classic in which extraterrestrials activate 'Plan 9' in San Fernando Valley to stop humanity from building a world-ending solar bomb.

items.title: Suddenly
items.summary: Frank Sinatra stars as a ruthless gunman who seizes a hilltop home overlooking a small California railroad depot ahead of a presidential train stop.

items.title: Teenagers from Outer Space
items.summary: A young alien scout breaks ranks with his invasion crew to warn a small American town before giant crustacean Gargons overrun Earth.

items.title: The Brain That Wouldn't Die
items.summary: An obsessed transplant surgeon keeps his fiancée's severed head alive in a country laboratory while prowling the city for a replacement body.

items.title: The Hitch-Hiker
items.summary: Ida Lupino directs a taut desert thriller following two fishing buddies held at gunpoint on the road through Baja California by a sleepless fugitive.

items.title: The Last Man on Earth
items.summary: Vincent Price stars as Dr. Robert Morgan, the lone immune survivor of a global plague, fortifying his home by night while searching for a cure by day.

items.title: The Red House
items.summary: Edward G. Robinson guards a dark secret deep inside the woods bordering his isolated farmstead, warning his adopted daughter never to enter the woods.

items.title: Granny's Spring Tonic
items.summary: Spring time is here and Granny breaks out her tonic. Bank secretary Gloria Buckles takes papers to the mansion for Jed to sign, but she has designs on Jed and his millions. Mystic Nights Videos

items.title: Jed Buys Stock
items.summary: When Drysdale recommends that Jed to buy stock he misunderstands and buys farm animals. Mystic Nights Videos

items.title: Stamp Day for Superman
items.summary: George Reeves stars as Clark Kent and Superman in a special episode foiling a Metropolis jewel thief alongside Jimmy Olsen and Lois Lane.

items.title: The Big Ham
items.summary: A young woman is an apparent suicide victim, or is she? Ellen Corby stars in this exciting episode of Dragnet. Originally broadcast Jan 28, 1954

items.title: The Case of the Pennsylvania Gun
items.summary: The New Adventures of Sherlock Holmes "The Case of the Pennsylvania Gun" Originally aired November 1, 1954. Based on the novel "The Valley of Fear," Holmes and Watson are called to Sussex to investigate the murder of Squire John Douglas. The local inspector thinks he has it all figured out, but Holmes discovers the crime is more complicated than it looks.

items.title: Treasure of Santa Dolores
